question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a silver ball, Bob has a grey ball, and Claire has a teal ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) silver ball
(B) grey ball
(C) teal ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: (silver, grey, teal)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (grey, silver, teal)
2. Alice and Bob swap again: (silver, grey, teal)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (teal, grey, silver)
Bob has the grey ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
